general.name: Priya M.
general.headline: Calm, clinical, never pushy
general.text: Dr. Hale explained options without rushing me into injectables. Elise walked me through aftercare and the home routine. Midtown energy, but the suite feels private.

general.name: Rachel K.
general.headline: Booking and follow-up finally match the brand
general.text: I booked online, got clear reminders, and left with products that matched my plan. Feels like a real practice system — not a plugin bolted onto a pretty site.

lip-filler.name: Samantha L.
lip-filler.headline: Soft, natural — exactly what I asked for
lip-filler.text: I wanted hydration more than size. Swelling settled by day three and the shape still looks like me. Dr. Hale’s proportion talk beforehand made all the difference.

answers.question: What brought you to AestheticBiz?
answers.answer: I wanted subtle lip filler after seeing overdone results elsewhere.

answers.question: How was your experience with Dr. Hale and the team?
answers.answer: Consult was thorough. Elise kept me comfortable and sent clear aftercare the same day.

answers.question: How do you feel about your results so far?
answers.answer: Natural border definition — friends notice I look rested, not ‘done’.

answers.question: Would you recommend AestheticBiz? Why?
answers.answer: Yes — especially if you want conservative, anatomy-led injectables.

lip-filler.name: Megan T.
lip-filler.headline: 0.5 ml was the right call
lip-filler.text: Started conservative. Will top up later if needed. No pressure to go bigger on day one.

acne-treatment.name: Jordan A.
acne-treatment.headline: Finally a medical plan, not another shelf cycle
acne-treatment.text: Peels plus Clarify Gel and Barrier Cream at home. Weeks 3–4 I saw fewer new breakouts. Honest about the purge window.

pigmentation-treatment.name: Aisha R.
pigmentation-treatment.headline: Tone looks more even — SPF is non-negotiable
pigmentation-treatment.text: Pigment peel series plus the corrector Dr. Hale recommended. Melasma isn’t ‘gone forever’ and they were honest about that — which I appreciated.

jaw-chin-contouring.name: Daniel C.
jaw-chin-contouring.headline: Profile finally matches how I feel
jaw-chin-contouring.text: Chin filler for projection. Subtle in photos, obvious to me. Review at two weeks was reassuring.

excessive-sweating.name: Chris P.
excessive-sweating.headline: Underarms dry within two weeks
excessive-sweating.text: Mapped, treated, back to work same day. Changed how I dress for summer meetings.

demo-product-08.name: Nina V.
demo-product-08.headline: Pigment Corrector is part of my nightly stack
demo-product-08.text: Paired with Daily Defence + SPF after my peel series. Marks look quieter at eight weeks.

demo-product-03.name: Olivia S.
demo-product-03.headline: Hydra Essence after lip filler
demo-product-03.text: Skin felt tight the evening after — this dropper fixed the comfort issue without irritating the area.
